items.title: Toney trial date for alleged assault set for 2028
items.excerpt: England striker Ivan Toney will face trial over an alleged assault at a London nightclub in June 2028, during the European Championships of that summer.
body: England striker Ivan Toney will face trial over an alleged assault at a London nightclub in June 2028, during the European Championships of that summer.
The 30-year-old is accused of headbutting and punching Saber Da Silva during a confrontation at a nightclub in Wardour Street, central London, on December 6 last year.

Toney, who has been in the England squad for the last two major tournaments, appeared at Southwark Crown Court on Thursday morning and formally entered a not guilty plea to a charge of assault occasioning actual bodily harm.

During the five-minute hearing, a provisional trial date was set for the same court on June 12, 2028 - a few days after the start of Euro 2028 - by Judge Christopher Hehir, who told the defendant he was "sorry" about the delay.

body: Wesley Fofana missed the decisive spot kick as Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties to set up a Carabao Cup quarter-final against Andoni Iraola's former side Bournemouth.
Fofana, whose handball gifted Liverpool their equaliser from the spot in normal time, scooped his penalty into the Kop after Giorgi Mamardashvili had denied Chelsea debutant Emmanuel Emegha.

Valentin Barco, another substitute, also missed his spot kick, sending his effort onto the post, but Ryan Gravenberch was thwarted by Mike Penders and Kostas Tsimikas fired over to keep a dramatic shoot-out going before Joe Gomez capitalised on Emegha's miss and Fofana fired over.
